content.title: About
content.content: The chicken deli sandwich (or sub) is a sandwich that features tender marinated chicken breast, fresh vegetables, cheese, and sauce, placed inside a soft roll or a long baguette. It is commonly served in fast‑casual restaurants and cafés.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The chicken in a deli sandwich is often marinated in a blend of soy sauce, honey, and spices.
A "sub" is an American term for a long sandwich, frequently layered with multiple fillings.
Some venues add crispy bacon or avocado to boost flavor.
Chicken deli subs are popular in summer menus because of their light taste.
The original recipe often uses a whole‑grain roll, increasing its nutritional value.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Chicken breast provides high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Compared with red meat, chicken contains less saturated fat, making it more heart‑friendly.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Chicken is a good source of niacin (B3) and vitamin B6, which support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The sandwich supplies phosphorus, selenium, and zinc, important for bones and immunity.

items.title: Fiber from vegetables
items.content: Fresh veggies add dietary fiber that aids digestion.

items.title: Chicken allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Marinades and sauces can be high in salt; people with hypertension should watch portion size.

items.title: Cross‑contamination
items.content: Proper handling is essential to avoid contact with raw meat and prevent foodborne illness.

items.title: Gluten in the roll
items.content: Traditional rolls contain wheat; a gluten‑free alternative is needed for those with celiac disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The sandwich is usually served cut in half and can be eaten with hands or with a fork and knife. It pairs well with fries, a side salad, or a light yogurt‑based sauce.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Best enjoyed fresh. If you need to store it, wrap tightly in plastic film and keep refrigerated for up to 24 hours. Store the roll in a dry place and keep cooked chicken in an airtight container.
